upstream.description: Desktop app that automatically scans and blocks malicious MCP traffic in AI apps like Cursor, Claude, VS Code and Windsurf.

classification.analysis: MCP Defender is an Electron desktop app that transparently proxies all Model Context Protocol traffic between AI apps (Cursor, Claude, VS Code, Windsurf) and MCP servers, scanning requests and responses against a signature set to detect and block malicious tool calls such as command injection, SSH key leaks, and path traversal. It targets developers and security teams worried about supply-chain risk in the growing MCP tool ecosystem. The project was acquired by Docker in mid-2026, so this standalone repo now appears to be in maintenance/wind-down mode rather than active independent development.

use_cases.title: Detect and block malicious MCP tool call traffic
Audit which MCP servers an AI app is actually calling
